# GitHub Copilot instructions

## Repository purpose

This project is a product-to-content generator called Content Weaver.

It turns a website, repo, app, or product description into:
- sales scripts
- tutorials and explainers
- social content
- visual prompts
- launch copy
- storyboard ideas

## Priority principles

- Ground claims in actual product evidence.
- Prefer user value and business outcome language.
- Keep content practical and edit-ready.
- Maintain the concept of product storytelling and educational utility.
- Avoid making up features or unsupported claims.

## Preferred implementation style

- TypeScript-first for business logic
- modular service-based structure
- small, explicit utility functions
- clean, readable project organization
- examples and docs should stay aligned with feature behavior

## Good tasks

- adding output formats
- adding scrapers or repo analyzers
- improving prompt quality
- enhancing landing page messaging
- validating generated assets
- improving end-user examples

## Avoid

- unrelated app features
- hidden business logic
- magic values with no explanation
- vague marketing copy without concrete product context
